defects.class: ownership release omission (resource leak; not UB)
defects.description: asn1_print_info pushed a fresh BIO_f_prefix() BIO when the sink did not accept BIO_CTRL_SET_PREFIX, then detached it with BIO_pop on both the success and error exits without releasing it. The authority's asn1_print_info calls BIO_free(bio) after BIO_pop (asn1_parse.c:75-85). Every printed ASN.1 element whose sink is a plain memory/file BIO therefore leaked one BIO (and its method reference). Repeated ASN1_parse/ASN1_parse_dump calls leak without bound.
defects.fix: Track the pushed prefix BIO in a frame-local handle, free it after BIO_pop on both exits, and free the freshly allocated BIO when BIO_push refuses it. Allocation/release coordinates are unchanged (BIO_new/BIO_free are the same calls the authority makes).
defects.witness: authority differential by inspection: asn1_parse.c:64-85 err tail calls BIO_free(bio) after BIO_pop(bp). No unit test drives ASN1_parse_dump in-tree, so the repair is code-reviewed rather than runtime-witnessed (recorded as a residual).

unsafe_operations_introduced: src/asn1/der.rs: two new crates-seam BIO_free calls (BIO_push failure and post-BIO_pop release), each inside an existing SAFETY-annotated unsafe block; they release this frame's own fresh/pushed BIO.
